display.purpose: Anything the room reads aloud: stage titles, join code, secret word, winners.

motion.name: roster-arrive
motion.purpose: A name being written onto the roster.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A solid ballpoint sticker for the one next action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: hsl(229 88% 54%); color: #fff; font-family: 'Shantell Sans', cursive; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0 2rem; border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 hsl(229 70% 34%), 0 8px 18px -8px hsl(229 88% 54%); cursor: pointer; transition: translate .16s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .16s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate: 0 1px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 hsl(229 70% 34%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid hsl(333 100% 76%); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Highlighter Callout
components.description: A phrase swiped in highlighter: the round winner or a role reveal.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: inline-block; margin: 0; padding: 0 .25em; font-family: 'Shantell Sans', cursive; font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 800; color: hsl(236 40% 14%); background: hsl(150 72% 70%); rotate: -2deg; }

components.name: Taped Sheet
components.description: Raised paper held by tape, for forms.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; padding: 1.5rem; background: hsl(42 60% 99%); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(236 30% 10% / 12%), 0 10px 24px -8px hsl(236 30% 10% / 22%); } .ds-sheet::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -.5rem; left: 50%; width: 6rem; height: 1.5rem; translate: -50% 0; rotate: -3deg; background: hsl(48 40% 84% / 75%); }

components.name: Critter Sticker
components.description: A player's animal on its own sticker color.
components.css: .ds-critter { display: inline-block; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(25 80% 86%); border: 2px solid hsl(42 60% 99%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px hsl(236 30% 10% / 25%); }

narrative.overview: Every secret is a note passed in class. The host screen is the notebook page the room reads, and phones hold folded notes that open for one reader. Light mode is ruled paper and ballpoint; dark mode is a black-paper sketchbook and gel pens.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled paper with a margin line under every screen
Hand lettering for anything read aloud
Animal stickers with their own colors

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Text on a highlighter is always the on-highlight ink, and a highlighter owns a whole phrase.

rules.name: The Three Pens Rule
rules.body: Yellow means look here, pink means imposter, mint means Insider or win.

rules.name: The Read-It-Out-Loud Rule
rules.body: The room reads Shantell Sans; one person reads Atkinson.

dos: Start content after the margin line
One obvious next action per phone screen
donts: No space, astronaut or neon social-deduction styling
No labels or kickers above headings
No gradient text, glass or hard offset shadows
